rca_of_issue: Reproduction: call GET /api/payroll?period=YYYY-MM&outlet_id=<id> -> 500. Backend log shows asyncpg.exceptions.UndefinedColumnError: column "kasbon_date" does not exist at payroll work_rows query (server.py line ~1980). Additional logical defect: payroll kasbon sum uses created_at date window, so kasbon dated outside selected period but created now can be incorrectly deducted. Mitigation: use valid work_logs date field and kasbon.kasbon_date filters, then rerun test_iter22_kasbon_payroll.py and owner gaji UI flow.
